title: Switch the cover
brief: They are moving the ball across midfield. Watch who goes to it.
briefKid: They are passing across the pitch. Watch who goes to the ball.
question: Your #8 has stepped out to press. Where do you go?
questionKid: Your teammate is going to the ball. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: When the ball moves across, the cover moves with it: sit behind and inside whichever teammate is pressing, still in front of your centre-backs.
takeaway.kid: Ball moves across? Move across too, behind the teammate who went to the ball.

misconceptions.text: You stayed where the ball was; when it is switched, the cover has to switch with it.
misconceptions.textKid: The ball moved across, so you need to move across with it.

misconceptions.text: You stepped up level with your #8, so one pass beats you both; drop in behind them at an angle.
misconceptions.textKid: Don't stand next to your teammate; stand behind them.
